name: ekotrace-platform
description: Ekotrace GHG accounting platform (white-label ready). One codebase, many deployments.

scripts.app: npm run build -w @ekotrace/calc && npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run build -w @ekotrace/web && npm run serve -w @ekotrace/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ekotrace/calc && npm run build -w @ekotrace/api && npm run build -w @ekotrace/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/calc --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @ekotrace/calc && npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api
scripts.demo: npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run demo -w @ekotrace/api --
scripts.demo:fin: npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run demo:fin -w @ekotrace/api --
scripts.demo:cbam: npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run demo:cbam -w @ekotrace/api --
scripts.demo:ccts: npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run demo:ccts -w @ekotrace/api --
scripts.demo:brsr: npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run demo:brsr -w @ekotrace/api --
scripts.demo:uaemrv: npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run demo:uaemrv -w @ekotrace/api --
scripts.demo:energy: npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run demo:energy -w @ekotrace/api --
scripts.demo:compliance: npm run migrate -w @ekotrace/api && npm run demo:compliance -w @ekotrace/api --
